question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Of'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2 is: **'Of'.**
 
• **In this sentence, **we are trying to describe Atlas as a Titan possessing or characterized by "enormous strength."
 
• When denoting possession or characteristic, we use **"of."**

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *'In 700 BCE Greek post Hesiod wrote “Theogony” and “Work and Days”. In these mythologies, Atlas was a Titan **of** enormous strength. He along with other titans (3) ______ the gods of Mount Olympus. While the other Titans were banished to Tartarus after being defeated by the god Zeus as retribution, Atlas (4) _______ was forced to carry the earth and the sky for an eternity. In depictions of Atlas. obviously carved by human based on myths, he is shown as a stooped figure carrying the (5) _____ on his shoulders. Because of his association with the globe. maps began to be decorated with this image of Atlas. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's briefly look at the other options:
 
 
• **"From" **generally denotes origin, source, or starting point. It would not be correct in this context.
 
• **"In"** typically refers to a location or a state of being, and it is not appropriate here.
 
• **"At" **often denotes a specific position or place, which doesn't fit with the concept of possessing strength.
